questions.text: CSS 2017, 2018 · Pair: Dinghy / Dingy — Which meaning fits “Dinghy”?

options.A: A watery discharge from the eyes or nose
options.C: A person who examines data or situations in detail to explain them
options.D: A small open boat, often carried by a larger ship or used for leisure

questions.explanation:
Dinghy: A small open boat, often carried by a larger ship or used for leisure. Sentence: "When the ship's engine failed, the crew rowed ashore in a small dinghy."
Dingy: Gloomy and drab; dirty-looking. Sentence: "The students lived in a dingy room with cracked walls and a single dim bulb."
Source: CSS 2017, 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Callous / Callus — Which meaning fits “Callous”?

options.A: Showing cruel disregard for others' feelings; insensitive
options.B: Famous and respected within a field; distinguished
options.C: A current of cool air in a room; (British) a drink or a game piece
options.D: A hardened patch of skin caused by friction

questions.explanation:
Callous: Showing cruel disregard for others' feelings; insensitive. Sentence: "It was callous of the landlord to evict the widow in the middle of winter."
Callus: A thickened, hardened area of skin caused by repeated friction. Sentence: "Years of digging gave the farmer a thick callus on each palm."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Born / Borne — Which meaning fits “Born”?

options.A: A watery discharge from the eyes or nose
options.C: Brought into life (past participle of 'bear' used for birth)

questions.explanation:
Born: Brought into life (past participle of 'bear' used for birth). Sentence: "Quaid-e-Azam was born in Karachi in 1876."
Borne: Carried or endured (past participle of 'bear' in other senses). Sentence: "The full cost of the repairs was borne by the company, not the tenants."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018, 2023, 2024 · Pair: Faint / Feint — Which meaning fits “Faint”?

options.A: To scatter or plant seeds; (noun) a female pig
options.B: To fire a weapon; a new growth from a plant
options.C: Weak, barely perceptible; or to lose consciousness briefly
options.D: A deceptive movement meant to mislead an opponent

questions.explanation:
Faint: Weak, barely perceptible; or to lose consciousness briefly. Sentence: "After standing for hours in the heat, the old man felt faint and sat down; the music was so faint we could barely hear it."
Feint: A pretended attack or movement meant to deceive an opponent. Sentence: "The boxer made a feint with his left hand and then struck with his right."
Source: CSS 2018, 2023, 2024 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Lose / Loose — Which meaning fits “Lose”?

options.A: To kill violently (literary); (informal) to impress greatly
options.C: To be deprived of something; to fail to win (verb)
options.D: To cut wool or hair with large blades; to break under strain

questions.explanation:
Lose: To be deprived of something; to fail to win (verb). Sentence: "If you don't hold your ticket tightly, you may lose it in the crowd."
Loose: Not tight or firmly fixed; free (adjective). Sentence: "The screw was loose, so the shelf wobbled whenever anyone touched it."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Waiver / Waver — Which meaning fits “Waiver”?

options.A: The giving up of a right or claim; a document doing so
options.B: A tiny speck, especially of dust
options.C: The final part of a story or play in which the plot is resolved

questions.explanation:
Waiver: The giving up of a right or claim; a document doing so. Sentence: "The university granted her a fee waiver, so she did not have to pay tuition."
Waver: To be undecided; to flicker or move unsteadily. Sentence: "He wavered between law and medicine for months before choosing his career."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Shear / Sheer — Which meaning fits “Shear”?

options.A: Completely, entirely; or on the whole
options.B: (British, noun) a person who relies on another, especially financially
options.D: To cut wool or hair with large blades; to break under strain

questions.explanation:
Shear: To cut wool or hair with large blades; to break under strain. Sentence: "Every spring the farmers shear the sheep and sell the wool."
Sheer: Utter, absolute; very steep; (of fabric) very thin. Sentence: "The climbers stared up at the sheer cliff that rose straight from the sea; it was sheer luck that no one fell."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2018 · Pair: Resister / Resistor — Which meaning fits “Resister”?

options.A: To scatter or plant seeds; (noun) a female pig
options.B: An electrical component that limits current flow
options.C: To cry or shout loudly and noisily
options.D: A person who resists or opposes something

questions.explanation:
Resister: A person who resists or opposes something. Sentence: "As a resister of the occupation, he hid weapons and refused to obey the invaders' orders."
Resistor: An electrical component that opposes the flow of current. Sentence: "The electrician added a resistor to the circuit to stop the bulb from burning out."
Source: CSS 2018 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).
